issue.title: Incorrect etcd docker images architecture - amd64 images tagged as arm64

repository.name: etcd
repository.description: Distributed reliable key-value store for the most critical data of a distributed system

issue.body:
### What happened?

When I pulled etcd docker images from both `quay.io/coreos/etcd` and `gcr.io/etcd-development/etcd`, I cannot run it in Apple Silicon (arm64). So I inspected the image and saw the images are actually `amd64`

```bash
docker pull quay.io/coreos/etcd:v3.5.7-arm64
docker image inspect quay.io/coreos/etcd:v3.5.7-arm64
```

Result output: `"Architecture": "amd64"` (See detailed output below)


### What did you expect to happen?

The image should be correctly build with multiple archs

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

```bash
docker pull quay.io/coreos/etcd:v3.5.7-arm64
docker image inspect quay.io/coreos/etcd:v3.5.7-arm64
```

 v3.5.7
